method: Sum of Market Value (JPY) for holdings whose ISIN country-prefix = 'US', divided by sum of Market Value (JPY) for all foreign-equity holdings, from GPIF's annual individual-stock holdings disclosure. ISIN prefix is issuer/registration country, not MSCI's economic-exposure country classification, so this may differ slightly from GPIF's own MSCI-basis US weight (not separately published).
